components.name: Primary Institutional Button
components.description: Solid maroon background with pure white text, shifting darker on hover.
components.css:
.ds-btn-primary { background: #800000; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 10px 20px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; }
.ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #660000; }

components.name: Secondary Academic Button
components.description: Solid gold background for featured calls-to-action.
components.css:
.ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFC632; color: #1B2336; padding: 10px 20px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s; }
.ds-btn-secondary:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped with subtle tinted background for tags.
components.css: .ds-chip-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: rgba(255, 198, 50, 0.18); color: #1B2336; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css:
.ds-input { height: 40px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E2E5EB; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 12px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #222222; outline: none; transition: all 0.2s; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; }
.ds-input:focus { border-color: #800000; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(128, 0, 0, 0.12); }

components.name: Portal Service Card
components.description: Pure white surface with a hairline border for modules.

narrative.overview: This design system embodies an authoritative, dignified academic collegiate aesthetic merged with high-clarity modern utility. It reflects the rich heritage of public higher education—balancing traditional institutional solemnity with seamless day-to-day administrative and student life operations.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast typography featuring an expressive editorial serif for institutional weight, titles, and honorific headings, anchored by a neutral, legible geometric sans-serif for rigorous dashboard productivity and data grids.
Prestigious color accents derived from institutional identity: commanding academic maroon, warm luminous gold, grounded deep charcoal, and crisp light utility surfaces.
Department-aware chromatic theming that allows distinct sub-units to maintain their localized identity within the parent institutional superstructure.
